review_evidence: The README describes a Lean 4 extensible-effects library based on freer-monad style concrete effect rows.
LeanEff/Core.lean defines the mutual inductives Eff and Arrs and proves viewLAppend_rest_lt and viewL_rest_lt, which establish the size decrease used by Arrs.apply termination.
The remaining files define typed effect requests, handlers, reader/writer/state/exception effects, and worked examples; these are reusable formal interfaces rather than declaration-free tooling.
summary: Retain LeanEff: it defines a typed extensible-effects calculus and includes proof obligations used to justify its recursive execution machinery.
